root_text:
Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) Alert! 🚨

A highly contagious yet often overlooked virus, HMPV spreads through respiratory droplets and contaminated surfaces, causing infections similar to the common cold.
#HMPVAlert #StayInformed #Respiratory
